decision.explanation: Mario Magnozzi is directly stated to have represented AC Milan (D1S7) and later joined FC Nara-ShBFR Naro-Fominsk (D2S3). These two teams are distinct and valid representations. 'Inter Milan' (C2) is mentioned in the context of being a rival of AC Milan but not as a team Magnozzi represented, so it is excluded. 'Empoli' (C3) is referenced as a club where Magnozzi played before AC Milan but is marked as incidental and not the primary focus of the question.
